speech.heard: In South Sudan, 14.5% of primary teachers are women. In Belarus, it's 99.5%. South Sudan is the world's lowest, counting both full-time and part-time staff. India has 58.6%, while the USA has 87.5%. Stepping up the list, Moldova has 98.3%, Ukraine 98.6%, Kyrgyzstan 98.9% and Russia 99.3%. Belarus is the world's highest, where women account for 99.5% of primary teachers. What was the gender balance among your primary school teachers?
